description: OpenWiz 0.0.4 (the implementation): cloud status, thread spawn, a new thread's thread show and thread list, read by the new-thread proofs directly (A1 phase 1) and served by the fake through scenarios the A1 phase 2 tests write, which name these files by absolute path. Observed in spike run 3 (room-cli v131, 2026-10-30, structure only): cloud status's keys, types and nesting; the 9 harness ids; the effort labels; models present on codex (10) and claude-code (9), null on cursor and absent on the other 6; provider a string on 1 harness and null on 8; the thread show and thread list shapes (capture C).
synthetic_assumptions: Every value is invented: model names, plan and access labels, counts, ids, titles and times. Only keys, types, nesting, harness ids, effort labels and the model counts were observed.
Which harness carries the one non-null provider (pi here) was not recorded.

The attachments booleans, the capability booleans and each harness's own reasoning_levels values were not recorded per harness; every harness here uses the harness-level labels observed across the catalogue.
Every codex model lists low to max plus ultra, and every claude-code model low to max. Only the union per harness was observed.
localLogins has one key; its name was not recorded (synthetic-login).
cloud-status-not-ready and cloud-status-harnesses-null are source-read : ready was true and harnesses a list in run 3.
Every cloud-status-drift file is invented drift.

The spawn receipt is source-read, not observed: --json prints the new thread's row, written with status pending. Its keys here are the thread list row's (capture C). Every spawn-receipt-drift file and spawn-receipt-not-json.txt is invented.
The spawn error lines (Error: Failed to create thread: HTTP <status>: <message>) are source-read, not observed; they live in the adapter's DOCUMENTED_REFUSALS, not here.
thread show's pending and starting statuses and thread.lastError are source-read, not observed (capture C saw idle, active and error, and no lastError key).
thread-list.json has the 0.43.1 thread list row shape (capture C) for observations after an uncertain create; its pending status is source-read, and the row without createdAt is invented drift.

The project list with GitHub remotes is written by the tests, not committed here: the fixture scan accepts no URL outside example.invalid. Only gitRemoteUrl being null or not was observed (spike run 3), never a host.
